title: MTF-4 deterministic Strategy Challenger
purpose: Evaluate deterministic H4 context, H1 setup, M15 direction and M5 timing roles while preserving M15 as sole direction authority and stopping at Strategy Challenger eligibility.
entry_condition: MTF mode is explicitly enabled on M15 and required closed H4/H1/M5 role data is causally available.

transitions.action: Preserve M15 direction and apply H4 context gate
Latest fully closed M5 may veto timing but never reverse direction
Qualified optimizer evidence may register Strategy Challenger only

invariants: M15 is the sole directional owner.
H4/H1/M5 are veto-only and cannot originate or reverse direction.
Missing/future required role data fails closed.
MTF-4 does not introduce a future M5 ENTER/WAIT/CANCEL state machine.
failure_behavior: Any missing, stale, future or invalid role input returns SKIP/fail-closed.
Owner runtime/backtest evidence remains NOT_PROVEN until phase-end execution.
restart_behavior: GitHub source tests may rerun from the same immutable candidate; Owner runtime is deferred to phase end.
rollback_behavior: Failed source/runtime acceptance cannot mutate Strategy Champion.
